import numpy as np
import wave

w = wave.open('/home/ctfplayer/workspace/chal.wav')
n = w.getnframes()
sr = w.getframerate()
ch = w.getnchannels()
sw = w.getsampwidth()
print(f"frames={n} sr={sr} ch={ch} sw={sw} dur={n/sr:.2f}s")
data = np.frombuffer(w.readframes(n), dtype='<i2').reshape(-1, ch)
L = data[:,0].astype(np.float64)
R = data[:,1].astype(np.float64)
np.save('/home/ctfplayer/workspace/L.npy', L)
np.save('/home/ctfplayer/workspace/R.npy', R)

# Envelope of L channel
env = np.abs(L)
# smooth with 5ms window
win = int(0.005*sr)
kernel = np.ones(win)/win
env_s = np.convolve(env, kernel, mode='same')
np.save('/home/ctfplayer/workspace/envL.npy', env_s)

# find on/off segments (threshold relative to max)
mx = env_s.max()
print("max env:", mx)
thr = mx*0.05
above = env_s > thr
# find segments
d = np.diff(above.astype(int))
starts = np.where(d==1)[0]+1
ends = np.where(d==-1)[0]+1
if above[0]: starts = np.concatenate([[0], starts])
if above[-1]: ends = np.concatenate([ends, [len(above)]])
print(f"num segments: {len(starts)}")
for i,(s,e) in enumerate(zip(starts, ends)):
    print(f"seg {i}: {s/sr:.4f} - {e/sr:.4f}  dur={((e-s)/sr)*1000:.1f}ms")

import numpy as np
from scipy import signal

sr = 44100
L = np.load('/home/ctfplayer/workspace/L.npy')

# Full spectrogram with decent resolution
f, t, Sxx = signal.spectrogram(L, sr, nperseg=8192, noverlap=4096, window='hann')
Sdb = 10*np.log10(Sxx + 1e-12)

# For each time frame, find peak frequency and peak power
print("Time frames with peak freq > 3kHz (bursts):")
for i in range(len(t)):
    col = Sdb[:, i]
    pk = np.argmax(col)
    if f[pk] > 3000 and col[pk] > -100:
        print(f"t={t[i]:.3f} peak={f[pk]:.0f}Hz power={col[pk]:.1f}")

import numpy as np
from scipy import signal

sr = 44100
L = np.load('/home/ctfplayer/workspace/L.npy')

# Bandpass 3000-22000 Hz to isolate the bursts
sos = signal.butter(4, [3000, 22000], btype='band', fs=sr, output='sos')
Lf = signal.sosfilt(sos, L)
env = np.abs(signal.hilbert(Lf))
win = int(0.003*sr)
env_s = np.convolve(env, np.ones(win)/win, mode='same')

d = np.diff(above.astype(int))

import numpy as np
from scipy import signal

sr = 44100
L = np.load('/home/ctfplayer/workspace/L.npy')

# High resolution spectrogram of the whole file, focusing on time-frequency peaks
f, t, Sxx = signal.spectrogram(L, sr, nperseg=4096, noverlap=2048, window='hann')
Sdb = 10*np.log10(Sxx + 1e-12)

# For each time frame, find peaks above threshold
# print all peaks with power > 20 dB above median
med = np.median(Sdb)
print("median power:", med)

for i in range(len(t)):
    col = Sdb[:, i]
    if col.max() > med + 25:
        # find peaks (local maxima above threshold)
        pk = col.max()
        idx = np.where(col > med + 25)[0]
        # group consecutive
        groups = []
        cur = [idx[0]]
        for j in idx[1:]:
            if j - cur[-1] <= 2:
                cur.append(j)
            else:
                groups.append(cur)
                cur = [j]
        groups.append(cur)
        peaks = [(f[g[0]+np.argmax(col[g])], col[g].max()) for g in groups]
        peaks.sort(key=lambda x: -x[1])
        peaks = peaks[:6]
        print(f"t={t[i]:.3f}: " + " ".join(f"{fr:.0f}Hz({p:.0f})" for fr,p in peaks))

import numpy as np
from scipy import signal

sr = 44100
L = np.load('/home/ctfplayer/workspace/L.npy')

# Focus on burst region 22.5-31.5s
# First find burst boundaries precisely with envelope
seg = L[int(22.5*sr):int(31.5*sr)]
t0 = 22.5

# Envelope via Hilbert on bandpassed 3k-22k
sos = signal.butter(4, [3000, 22000], btype='band', fs=sr, output='sos')
Lf = signal.sosfilt(sos, seg)
env = np.abs(signal.hilbert(Lf))
win = int(0.002*sr)
env_s = np.convolve(env, np.ones(win)/win, mode='same')

above = env_s > env_s.max()*0.10
d = np.diff(above.astype(int))
starts = np.where(d==1)[0]+1
ends = np.where(d==-1)[0]+1
if above[0]: starts = np.concatenate([[0], starts])
if above[-1]: ends = np.concatenate([ends, [len(above)]])

print("Bursts in 22.5-31.5s:")
bursts = []
for i,(s,e) in enumerate(zip(starts, ends)):
    dur = (e-s)/sr
    if dur > 0.01:
        st = s/sr + t0
        en = e/sr + t0
        bursts.append((st, en))
        print(f"burst {i}: {st:.4f}-{en:.4f} dur={dur*1000:.1f}ms gap={bursts[-1][0]-bursts[-2][1] if len(bursts)>1 else 0:.3f}")

# For each burst, get precise tone frequencies via FFT
print("\nTone content per burst:")
for st, en in bursts:
    s0 = int(st*sr)
    s1 = int(en*sr)
    chunk = L[s0:s1]
    # window
    n = len(chunk)
    win = np.hanning(n)
    spec = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(chunk*win))
    freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(n, 1/sr)
    # find peaks
    thresh = spec.max()*0.15
    idx = np.where(spec > thresh)[0]
    groups = []
    cur = [idx[0]]
    for j in idx[1:]:
        if j - cur[-1] <= 3:
            cur.append(j)
        else:
            groups.append(cur)
            cur = [j]
    groups.append(cur)
    tones = []
    for g in groups:
        # parabolic interpolation
        k = g[0]+np.argmax(spec[g])
        if 0 < k < len(spec)-1:
            a,b,c = spec[k-1], spec[k], spec[k+1]
            dk = 0.5*(a-c)/(a-2*b+c)
            fk = (k+dk)*sr/n
        else:
            fk = freqs[k]
        tones.append((fk, spec[k]/spec.max()))
    tones.sort(key=lambda x:-x[1])
    print(f"{st:.3f}-{en:.3f}: " + " ".join(f"{fr:.1f}Hz({amp:.2f})" for fr,amp in tones[:8]))

# High resolution spectrogram of the whole file, focusing on time-frequency peaks
f, t, Sxx = signal.spectrogram(L, sr, nperseg=4096, noverlap=2048, window='hann')

# For each time frame, find peaks above threshold
# print all peaks with power > 20 dB above median
med = np.median(Sdb)
print("median power:", med)

for i in range(len(t)):
    col = Sdb[:, i]
    if col.max() > med + 25:
        # find peaks (local maxima above threshold)
        pk = col.max()
        idx = np.where(col > med + 25)[0]
        # group consecutive
        groups = []
        cur = [idx[0]]
        for j in idx[1:]:
            if j - cur[-1] <= 2:
                cur.append(j)
            else:
                groups.append(cur)
                cur = [j]
        groups.append(cur)
        peaks = [(f[g[0]+np.argmax(col[g])], col[g].max()) for g in groups]
        peaks.sort(key=lambda x: -x[1])
        peaks = peaks[:6]
        print(f"t={t[i]:.3f}: " + " ".join(f"{fr:.0f}Hz({p:.0f})" for fr,p in peaks))

from scipy import signal

sr = 44100
L = np.load('/home/ctfplayer/workspace/L.npy')

# Focus on burst region 22.5-31.5s
# First find burst boundaries precisely with envelope
seg = L[int(22.5*sr):int(31.5*sr)]
t0 = 22.5

# Envelope via Hilbert on bandpassed 3k-22k
sos = signal.butter(4, [3000, 22000], btype='band', fs=sr, output='sos')
Lf = signal.sosfilt(sos, seg)
env = np.abs(signal.hilbert(Lf))
win = int(0.002*sr)
env_s = np.convolve(env, np.ones(win)/win, mode='same')

above = env_s > env_s.max()*0.10
d = np.diff(above.astype(int))
starts = np.where(d==1)[0]+1
ends = np.where(d==-1)[0]+1
if above[0]: starts = np.concatenate([[0], starts])
if above[-1]: ends = np.concatenate([ends, [len(above)]])

print("Bursts in 22.5-31.5s:")
bursts = []
for i,(s,e) in enumerate(zip(starts, ends)):
    dur = (e-s)/sr
    if dur > 0.01:
        st = s/sr + t0
        en = e/sr + t0
        bursts.append((st, en))
        print(f"burst {i}: {st:.4f}-{en:.4f} dur={dur*1000:.1f}ms gap={bursts[-1][0]-bursts[-2][1] if len(bursts)>1 else 0:.3f}")

# For each burst, get precise tone frequencies via FFT
print("\nTone content per burst:")
for st, en in bursts:
    s0 = int(st*sr)
    s1 = int(en*sr)
    chunk = L[s0:s1]
    # window
    n = len(chunk)
    win = np.hanning(n)
    spec = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(chunk*win))
    freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(n, 1/sr)
    # find peaks
    thresh = spec.max()*0.15
    idx = np.where(spec > thresh)[0]
    groups = []
    cur = [idx[0]]
    for j in idx[1:]:
        if j - cur[-1] <= 3:
            cur.append(j)
        else:
            groups.append(cur)
            cur = [j]
    groups.append(cur)
    tones = []
    for g in groups:
        # parabolic interpolation
        k = g[0]+np.argmax(spec[g])
        if 0 < k < len(spec)-1:
            a,b,c = spec[k-1], spec[k], spec[k+1]
            dk = 0.5*(a-c)/(a-2*b+c)
            fk = (k+dk)*sr/n
        else:
            fk = freqs[k]
        tones.append((fk, spec[k]/spec.max()))
    tones.sort(key=lambda x:-x[1])
    print(f"{st:.3f}-{en:.3f}: " + " ".join(f"{fr:.1f}Hz({amp:.2f})" for fr,amp in tones[:8]))
"}
